courses.name: L.L.M. (One Year Programme)
courses.eligibility: Passed LL.B. or equivalent degree from a recognized university with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade, or 45% for SC/ST candidates of Uttar Pradesh; candidates appearing in the final qualifying examination must have passed or appeared by admission.

courses.name: Ph.D. Degree in Law and Allied Subjects
courses.duration: Minimum three years including coursework; maximum six years from the date of admission.
courses.eligibility: Law stream: LL.M. from RMLNLU or an equivalent UGC-recognized degree with at least 55% aggregate or equivalent UGC 7-point grade, with stated 5% relaxation for eligible categories. Allied subjects: a UGC-recognized master's degree with at least 55% or equivalent grade in the proposed research subject plus a bachelor's degree in law, established research credentials through publications, or long-term in-depth practical experience; social-science or humanities research must interface with law.

agent_notes: Normal TLS failed with the managed proxy's exact self-signed-certificate-in-chain error; curl --insecure was used only for public GETs to the expected nirfindia.org, search engine, and rmlnlu.ac.in hosts.
The exact institution name, Lucknow city, and Uttar Pradesh state were verified in both supplied NIRF 2025 listings.

The current official homepage's Admissions menu and Majors & Academic Programs section enumerate the two law degrees, one combined Ph.D. programme, three postgraduate diplomas, and three foreign-language certificate tracks; every linked catalogue page was fetched.

The official Law and Humanities & Social Sciences routes expose one combined Ph.D. in Law and Allied Subjects with Law, social-science, and humanities streams, represented as one programme with stream mappings.

Career-tree mappings were obtained with read-only sqlite3 queries. The Spanish certificate uses a low-confidence closest existing foreign-language node because the tree label lists French/German/Japanese while the official catalogue also includes Spanish.
